android.desc:
Kash is a simple, offline-first personal finance tracker that automatically logs transactions from your bank SMS notifications — so you always know where your money goes without manual entry.

What you can do with Kash

- Enable Notification Access to auto-log transactions with smart account and category detection
- Track cash, bank accounts, credit cards, and investments in one place
- Organise expenses with categories and sub-categories for finer breakdowns
- See balances and net totals across all your accounts at a glance
- Track credit card dues separately from your cash balances
- Track investment portfolio value independently from spendable money
- Set up recurring transactions to match your monthly routine
- Export your transactions as an Excel spreadsheet
- Migrate from another app — import data from My Money or Money Manager
- Back up to Google Drive automatically every day, or restore whenever you need

Privacy

Your finances are personal. Kash works entirely on your device with no sign-in required. Backups go to your own Google Drive's private app folder — not accessible to anyone else.

Disclaimer

Kash is a personal tracking tool and does not provide financial advice.
